name: Bhagavad Gita 16.3
text:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ॥
meaning: Radiance, forgiveness, steadiness, purity, freedom from malice and from excessive pride: these belong to one born with divine qualities.
purpose: Qualities such as radiance, forgiveness, steadiness, purity and humility.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
